chunk.text: 6.16.1 Changes during product development/ 产品开发中的更改 6.16.1 Changes during product development/ 产品开发中的更改 During the product engineering process, changes to the released design input document and the resulting adaptations to design output documents must be performed in accordance with [1]. If necessary, regulations deviating from these stipulations may be set out in the quality management plan to cover the correction of documents during the development phase but prior to completion of verification. If applicable error tracking is performed according to defect management process. 在产品开发过程中， 对已经发布的设计输入文档 和设计输出文档结果的调整必须遵照[1]的流程。 必要的时候，对这些操作的偏差需要在 QMP 中 列出以覆盖在开发过程中的文档更正， 但是要早 于验证完成前。 如果适用，错误跟踪将根据缺陷管理流程进行。
